verdict.rationale: Kimi's help center lists a section on installing, creating, and publishing Kimi plugins and skills. That points to a first-party plugin ecosystem users can add to the assistant, but the evidence is only a single index-heading mention. Nothing documents a browsable directory or marketplace, third-party connectors, or how adding one works. missing for 10: evidence of a browsable directory/marketplace of third-party apps, documented connector install flow, catalog of available third-party connectors, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can browse a directory of third-party apps and connectors and add them to the assistant

citations.quote: 插件和技能 安装、创建和发布 Kimi 插件与技能
